evidence.mechanism: TransmitResponse is a coroutine that initiates stream.BeginWrite, then yields return null each frame until EndWriteFinished or a ResponseWriteTimeoutMilliseconds (1000 ms) deadline expires, closing the client on timeout. EndWrite is completed on a ThreadPool work item, so the main thread never blocks on a non-reading peer.

runtimeDebuggingAudit.rootCause: H4. scripts/smoke_protection.nested_manifest_digest builds a complete nested manifest of the active data root by enumerating every entry. At 14.4 million files the enumeration takes minutes, and the smoke driver performs it twice per run, before and after. The engine phase is comparatively short, so total wall clock is dominated by two full metadata scans of a 535 GB tree.
